operations.summary: List granted or built render templates.
Read exposed variables, required values, budgets, outputs and contractHash.
operations.conditions: Use bindingId from discovery when the key matches multiple workspaces.

operations.summary: List saved sets, optionally filtered by templateKey.
Read saved rows, inherited effective values and delivery settings.
Read kept states of a set.
Read delivery and approval destinations.
List render jobs, optionally filtered by templateKey, setId, batchId or status.
Refresh a single render job and its output files.
Read a batch, waiting briefly for its jobs to settle.
operations.completion: Bounded wait: waitSeconds 0–55; use 50 in a background task until done=true.

operations.summary: List accessible 3D scenes and their fillable keys.
Compare two rows or two kept states as rendered.
operations.conditions: Supply rowIds=[a,b], or fromRevision with optional toRevision (default: current).

operations.summary: Read branches, revision history, publications and the default variant.
Read editable compositions and layers of a revision.
Read a revision and its source identity.
Compare edits of two revisions of one template.
Read the publishing run for this exact revision source.
List the brand’s uploaded template sources and parse/build state.
Save rows for one template.
operations.conditions: Use bindingId when ambiguous; templateRevisionId, when supplied, must identify a published revision.

operations.summary: Update a saved set with a revision check.
operations.conditions: settings merges named keys; null clears nullable settings. Prefer rows_patch for surgical row changes.

operations.summary: Copy the current set or one of its kept states.
Delete a saved render set.
operations.confirmation: Ask for an explicit yes before calling. This action directly deletes; it does not issue its own confirmationToken.

operations.summary: Draft values from a brief, documents or media.
operations.conditions: Provide setId or templateKey, and prompt or documentIds or mediaAssetIds. parentRowId requires setId.
operations.confirmation: Use only when the person’s request authorizes AI drafting and its potential model spend; that request is sufficient consent. No server confirmation token is issued.

operations.summary: Append selected draft rows once.
operations.conditions: Every selected row must retain its draft id.

operations.summary: Create a signed-in mixed-file upload handoff.
operations.confirmation: Explain automatic preparation and smoke-render spend and obtain permission BEFORE completing an eligible source upload; waiting for template_forge does not prevent it.
operations.completion: Returns inline; upload, parsing and eligible preparation continue separately.

operations.summary: Read upload readiness and classified resource IDs.
Validate selected rows and show where each result will go.
operations.conditions: Omitted delivery/final settings inherit from the saved set; inspect them. null slackDestinationId disables posting. final=true requires Admin/Owner.

operations.summary: Redeem the reviewed preflight token and queue the batch.
operations.confirmation: Show readiness, rows and destinations; wait for the person’s yes, then pass the exact returned confirmationToken.
operations.completion: Returns a batch immediately; read forge_query batch/job.

operations.summary: Fill an accessible scene from the brand and brief.
operations.conditions: Use assetId/versionId/output IDs returned by scenes.

operations.summary: Redeem a reviewed scene fill and queue its outputs.
operations.conditions: The service reloads the current scene at submission; immutable scene-version execution is not guaranteed. Recheck scenes before confirming; if it changed, fill/review again.
operations.confirmation: Show filled values and outputs, explain potential spend (estimate may be unavailable), wait for a yes, then pass the exact scene_fill token.
operations.completion: Scene jobs use the template’s scene history in Forge and the Library; they are not Forge render-set batches.

operations.summary: Upsert or remove selected rows with a revision check.
operations.conditions: Supply nonempty rows or removeRowIds. Ask for explicit consent before removing rows.

operations.summary: Pin an existing set to a published template revision.
Preview proposed edits without saving a revision.
operations.conditions: Read template_layers first. Edits are also checked against the revision edit contract.

operations.summary: Save edits as a new immutable revision.
operations.conditions: Exactly one of name (new branch) or variantId (extend its current head). Requires a signed-in user session.
operations.confirmation: Obtain explicit permission for saving and its automatic preparation/spend BEFORE template_save; there is no separate render-preview token for this path.

operations.summary: Start or advance publication of an eligible revision source.
operations.conditions: step=start needs templateName; step=decisions needs decisions. Native HTML/components/Blender do not use this action.
operations.confirmation: Obtain explicit permission for this publishing run and its smoke-render spend before starting; this action has no render_preview token.
operations.completion: Returns inline; inspect template_run while the run continues.

operations.summary: Choose the variant everyone opens by default.
